harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Created a local root CA named "OS Comparison Root CA" on node1 (AlmaLinux 9) via openssl, installed it into the system trust store via update-ca-trust, and verified end-to-end trust with a signed leaf certificate both before and after a full node reboot.
actions_performed: Inspected node1 OS (AlmaLinux 9.6) and available tooling (openssl, update-ca-trust)
Generated a 4096-bit RSA key and self-signed X.509 root CA cert with CN=OS Comparison Root CA at /etc/pki/CA/os-comparison-root-ca/
Verified the cert is self-signed with correct subject/issuer and 10-year validity
Copied the CA cert into /etc/pki/ca-trust/source/anchors/ and ran update-ca-trust extract
Confirmed the CA is listed as a trust anchor via `trust list` and present in the extracted tls-ca-bundle.pem
Issued a test leaf certificate signed by the new CA and confirmed `openssl verify` succeeds against the system trust store
Captured baseline boot_id/uptime and CA trust state on node1
Rebooted node1 via `shutdown -r now`, confirmed disconnect then reconnect
Confirmed boot_id and boot time changed, proving an actual restart occurred
Re-verified the CA trust anchor persisted and re-ran the leaf-certificate trust test post-reboot

evidence.requirement: Local CA 'OS Comparison Root CA' created
evidence.summary: Generated key and self-signed cert; subject/issuer confirmed as CN=OS Comparison Root CA

evidence.requirement: CA installed as trusted system CA
evidence.summary: Copied to /etc/pki/ca-trust/source/anchors/, ran update-ca-trust extract, confirmed trust anchor listed and present in extracted bundle

evidence.requirement: Proof the CA is functionally trusted (not just filed)
evidence.summary: Leaf cert signed by the new CA verifies OK via openssl's default system trust store
Captured boot_id, uptime, and confirmed CA trust anchor + file present before reboot
shutdown -r now issued in background; command returned 'reboot-issued' before node dropped

evidence.requirement: Node restart proof via changed boot identity
evidence.summary: Connection timed out during reboot, then reconnected; boot_id changed from dfdea52d... to 9b262cfe..., and uptime -s changed, proving an actual restart
Trust anchor still listed and CA file present post-reboot; leaf certificate signed by the CA verifies OK against system trust store after restart
